authority: Design-remediation evidence only; future machine source authority remains the BPF-U01 generated source inventory.

input.applicability: exactly the 45 non-M1 COMMAND rows whose cur.tx and cur.chain are path anchors

deterministicRule.rule: For each row, reopen the declared edge method, select the invocation of its declared source-ledger action on an injected com.catering.v2s owner/protocol API or application field, and derive path#method from that field type. Never use the final arbitrary method reference in an argument expression.
rejections: A derived cur anchor under apps/backend/catering-business-server/src/main/java/com/catering/v2s/app/edge/ is invalid.
A derived cur anchor outside an owner/protocol application or API package is invalid.
An ambiguous or absent declared owner/protocol field invocation is invalid and must remain an explicit GAP, never inferred.
deterministicRule.boundary: This derives the edge dispatch/current chain anchor. The future source inventory separately resolves concrete transaction origin versus JOIN_EXISTING_REQUIRED_PARTICIPANT; an interface dispatch or owner-local delegating overload is not falsely rejected merely because it is not a concrete implementation body.

claudeStrictConcreteBodyReconciliation.initializeCommercialGroup: MATCH under EDGE_DECLARED_OWNER_PROTOCOL_FIELD_CALL_V1 because the edge dispatches its declared PlatformWorkspaceCoordinator API field; BPF-U01 must later resolve the concrete origin/participant implementation separately.
claudeStrictConcreteBodyReconciliation.stagePlatformAsset: MATCH under EDGE_DECLARED_OWNER_PROTOCOL_FIELD_CALL_V1 because the edge dispatches its declared PlatformAssetService field; BPF-U01 must later classify the owner-local overload/implementation separately.
claudeStrictConcreteBodyReconciliation.reason: The requested deterministic rule prevents arbitrary trailing-argument capture without misclassifying valid public API dispatch as an edge anchor.

requiredPermanentControls: The BPF-U01 source inventory rederives every non-M1 current chain with this rule and rejects an app/edge derived anchor.
It emits an exact mismatch report before any origin convergence source edit and fails on absent, ambiguous or out-of-owner/protocol dispatch.
It separately classifies concrete transactional methods as ORIGIN or JOIN_EXISTING_REQUIRED_PARTICIPANT; the cur dispatch anchor is never treated as runtime transaction proof.
